verdict.rationale: Sift documents Review Queues alongside Workflows (sift-docs-12), risk scores an agent could use as context (sift-docs-5), and a Decisions API for recording outcomes (sift-docs-3, sift-docs-7). The founder also notes that most customers have a human make the final go/no-go call on flagged users (sift-comm-4), which fits the agent-recommends, human-confirms pattern. However, nothing shows an agent can programmatically pull queued cases with their context, or that Sift offers agent-facing access or AI summaries; any agent would have to be assembled from the general REST APIs. Missing for 10: a documented API to list and fetch review-queue cases with full context, agent/LLM or MCP integration, evidence summarization, decision-recommendation support, and hands-on corroboration.
